run_segmentation_server: run the segmentation server as a zmq service listening on a configured port
load_model_owlvit_or_sam: load the OwlV2 object detection model or SAM segmentation model onto a device
detect_objects_with_owlv2: detect objects in an image using text queries and the OwlV2 model with a score threshold
segment_image_with_sam: segment an image using SAM given bounding boxes and return binary masks
segment_with_socket_client: send an image and bounding box to the segmentation server via zmq and receive a mask
